name: Coin flip for first player
requires: none
effect_summary: Winner of the flip decides who goes first

name: Draw opening hand
requires: none
effect_summary: Each player shuffles the deck and draws 7 cards

name: Mulligan
requires: No Basic Pokémon in the opening hand
effect_summary: Reveal the hand and shuffle it back and draw 7 again until it has a Basic Pokémon; the opponent may draw 1 extra card per extra mulligan taken; if both players mulligan equally both restart

name: Place Active Pokémon
requires: A Basic Pokémon in hand
effect_summary: Put 1 Basic Pokémon face down as the Active Pokémon

name: Place starting Bench
requires: A Basic Pokémon in hand
effect_summary: Put up to 5 more Basic Pokémon face down on the Bench

name: Set Prize cards
requires: none
effect_summary: Put the top 6 cards of the deck face down as Prize cards

name: Draw a card
requires: Start of the player's turn
effect_summary: Draw 1 card; a player who cannot draw at the start of their turn loses

name: Bench a Basic Pokémon
requires: Fewer than 5 Pokémon on the Bench
effect_summary: Put a Basic Pokémon from hand onto the Bench

name: Evolve a Pokémon
requires: The card says Evolves from X and X was in play at the start of the turn and has not evolved or entered play this turn and it is not the player's first turn
effect_summary: Play the card on top of X; it keeps attached cards and damage counters; Special Conditions and attack effects end

name: Mega Evolution ends the turn
requires: A Pokémon becomes a Mega Evolution Pokémon
effect_summary: Under the 2023 rulebook the turn ends when a Pokémon becomes a Mega Evolution Pokémon; not confirmed for Mega Evolution ex cards

name: Attach Energy
requires: Energy card in hand
effect_summary: Attach 1 Energy card from hand to the Active or a Benched Pokémon

name: Play Item
requires: Item card in hand
effect_summary: Follow the card text then discard it

name: Play Supporter
requires: Supporter card in hand and not the first turn of the player who goes first
effect_summary: Follow the card text then discard it

name: Play Stadium
requires: Stadium card in hand and no Stadium with the same name in play
effect_summary: The Stadium stays in play and an older Stadium is discarded

name: Attach Pokémon Tool
requires: Tool card in hand and the target Pokémon has no Tool attached
effect_summary: Attach the Tool to one of your Pokémon

name: Retreat
requires: Active Pokémon is not Asleep or Paralyzed and there is a Benched Pokémon and enough Energy for the Retreat Cost
effect_summary: Discard Energy equal to the Retreat Cost then swap the Active with a Benched Pokémon; Special Conditions and attack effects end; the player may still attack

name: Use an Ability
requires: Per the Ability text
effect_summary: An Active or Benched Pokémon uses its Ability; Abilities are not attacks so the player can still attack

name: Play a Fossil as a Basic Pokémon
requires: Fossil Item card in hand
effect_summary: A Fossil Item can be played as a Basic Pokémon; it is not a Basic Pokémon in hand deck or discard pile

name: Attack
requires: Active Pokémon has the Energy for the attack cost and is not Asleep or Paralyzed and the player going first cannot attack on their first turn
effect_summary: Announce the attack; Confusion check; make choices; apply effects and damage; then the turn ends

name: End turn
requires: An attack was made or the player chose to stop
effect_summary: The turn ends after an attack; ending without attacking is not stated explicitly

name: Pokémon Checkup
requires: Between turns
effect_summary: Apply Special Conditions in order Poisoned Burned Asleep Paralyzed and card effects that happen at Checkup without mixing the two; after both players' checks Knock Outs are resolved

name: Knock Out
requires: Damage on a Pokémon is at least its HP
effect_summary: The Pokémon and all attached cards go to the discard pile; the opponent takes Prize cards (1 or 2 for Pokémon ex); the owner chooses a new Active from the Bench

name: Win check
requires: After each Knock Out and at the start of each turn
effect_summary: A player wins by taking the last Prize card or when the opponent has no Pokémon in play or cannot draw at the start of their turn; if both players win at once play Sudden Death with 1 Prize card
